caption: The drawing depicts two knitted mittens positioned side by side, with the left mitten appearing slightly in front of the right mitten. Both mittens are decorated with geometric patterns and are composed primarily of red and dark blue colors. The left mitten features a design of diamond shapes and zigzag patterns. Its background is predominantly red with the diamond motifs rendered in dark blue, and the pattern is consistent across the entire mitten, including the thumb area. The cuff of the left mitten has horizontal dark blue lines interspersed near the edge. The right mitten, which is slightly larger, showcases horizontal bands of alternating zigzag and diamond patterns. The cuffs of both mittens are decorated with a series of vertical blue lines or rectangles against the red knitting, with the right mitten’s cuff having a more pronounced columnar pattern. Both mittens have pointed tips at the end and rounded shapes at the finger and thumb sections. The drawing is set against a plain, neutral background.
title: Mitten
